summary: Former lookout site in Morgan County, Indiana. A tower is shown on a 1955 topographic map and is listed as gone. No source found describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as not standing; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, builder, staffing, fire history or description of the site today was found in the cached pages or two web searches. The Indiana site's 1955 map and a Morgan County historical society newspaper article are images and were not read as text. The Indiana site's coordinates (39.5148, -86.5008, marked unofficial) differ slightly from the Association's (39.51455, -86.50036); no correction proposed. The Eastern US lookouts page for Wilbur is a bare listing and is not cited.
